Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one original standing portrait for Batwalk, an imaginative cozy collectible virtual-pet game for Apple Watch.
Primary request: invent the single character below with its OWN visual concept, construction, face language and personality. Share only a gentle pixel-art rendering language across the roster. The visual idea must shape the whole creature, not be a hat placed on a standard mascot. Think of the charming strangeness and individual identities of classic virtual-pet rosters, but create an original character without copying existing franchise characters.
Style: authentic coarse 64x64-style pixel art enlarged to a square canvas. Bold deliberate square pixel clusters, tidy stepped edges, warm colored dark outlines, restrained small palette, 2 or 3 flat shade levels. Cheerful, warm, memorable, a little odd. Minimal enough to read at 64 pixels. No painterly gradients, fuzzy aura, smooth vector edges, realistic fur, microscopic detailing, or glossy 3D.
Composition: one complete character in an expressive resting/standing portrait pose, centered with at least 10% empty margin on every side. Genuine transparent background, no ground or shadow, no text, labels, panels, scenery, extra characters or detached particles. All integral ears, wings and feet visible. Design any explicitly specified small object as part of the single portrait. Friendly, never horror. Do not default to the same egg-shaped bat with two huge ears, huge glossy eyes, a cream oval tummy and symmetrical generic spread wings.
CHARACTER:
The welcoming starter MOCHI. A soft warm biscuit-colored round dumpling, two rounded ears and a modest cream chin. Its cocoa bat wings wrap asymmetrically around its front like a blanket; one wing sits just under its mouth, the other slightly open, suggesting it will peek out. Two gentle little black oval eyes, one tiny sideways smile, peach cheeks, stubby feet. Body is a single round kneaded mochi mass, ears soft rather than rabbit-like. One folded ear tip. A shy friendly creature, recognizably a bat. This one may be round, with simple cozy mascot proportions; do not add food props or clothing.
